purpose: Decide in advance whether every fixed Train/Val terrain window is the published Moonstone product, and record exactly which provenance claims that does and does not support.

grid.byte_order: little-endian, headerless C order for values; NumPy v1 header for the packed mask
grid.row_index_origin: north pole row 0 (89.996 deg centre latitude at 128 ppd)

assets.role: byte-identical to elevation_mask.npy at this revision, hence the same published NaN pattern
assets.note: slope_mask.npy is byte-identical to elevation_mask.npy at this revision and was downloaded and SHA256-verified separately on 2026-11-10

assets.role: published mean/std used by step15 during conversion

normalization.stats_source: pretraining/channel_stats.json (byte-identical to the locally retained file)
normalization.convention: z = (x - mean) / std evaluated in float32; non-finite pixels are replaced by 0 after normalization (step15_build_mmap.py)

mask_semantics.encoding: np.packbits(~np.isfinite(data).ravel()) with default big-endian bit order; row stride 5760 bytes, tile stride 32 bytes
mask_semantics.meaning: a set bit marks a source pixel that the pinned builder treated as non-finite; 0 means the published product declares a finite value there
mask_semantics.caveat: finite does not imply an un-interpolated measurement; the blend of SLDEM inside 58 deg, LOLA outside 62 deg, linear 58-62 deg transition and LOLA fallback where SLDEM is non-finite is the publisher's declared construction

data_preparation/step04_tile.py.claim: HDF5 channel 1 is read from aligned/elevation_blended.tif and channel 2 from derived/slope.tif by rasterio window, in physical units with no normalization

data_preparation/step15_build_mmap.py.claim: mmap values are the same GeoTIFF band 1 pixel grid, float32, NaN to 0, then z-scored with channel_stats.json; the mask is packbits(~isfinite)

data_preparation/step02_align.py.claim: elevation_blended.tif is SLDEM inside 58 deg, LOLA outside 62 deg, a linear blend between, and keeps LOLA where SLDEM is non-finite; reprojection uses bilinear resampling

config.py.claim: channel order, grid constants and the elevation/slope file bindings used by both steps

mapping.identity_gate: the frozen P31 Train/Val IDs, targets and counts must still match before any comparison
mapping.tile_rule: y0 = row_idx * 256, x0 = col_idx * 256, 256 rows and 256 columns
mapping.test_policy: no Test ID is selectable; the 256x256 tiles of Train/Val are disjoint from Test tiles, so no held-out pixel is read

comparison.derived: float32 z-score of the retained HDF5 physical terrain slice using the published statistics
comparison.note: tolerance identical to the pre-registered P3.0 fixed-row probe; exact equality is also counted and reported

criteria.pass: all 6,290 Train/Val rows have zero pixels beyond tolerance in both channels and zero declared-NaN bits inside the tile
criteria.fail: any row exceeds the tolerance, any declared-NaN bit falls inside a fixed Train/Val tile, or the published mask files disagree with each other
criteria.blocked: asset size/SHA256 mismatch, truncated download, or missing authenticated metadata

claims_permitted: Every fixed Train/Val elevation and slope pixel is numerically and bit-for-bit equal to the published pretraining/mmap window at the stated tolerance, with the same declared NaN pattern

The published mmap channel is produced by the pinned step15 builder from the same 128 ppd GeoTIFF grid that step04 uses for the HDF5 patch, so the cohort equals the published product form of those GeoTIFFs
The publisher declares no non-finite terrain pixel anywhere; finite values may still be bilinear-interpolated or blended as described by step02
Whole-file SHA256 hashing and the global mask count stream bytes that cover all latitudes, including Test geography; no Test tile is selected, decoded, compared or scored
claims_not_permitted: A byte-level comparison against aligned/elevation_blended.tif or derived/slope.tif; the latter is not published and only the mmap form is available
Independent re-execution or byte-level authentication of the raw LOLA/SLDEM ingestion, GDAL versions, intermediate reuse or per-stage headers
A guarantee that no possible undocumented finite sentinel arises from interpolation or blending
Any model execution, training, actual budget lock, transfer score or held-out result
Equivalence of the Git-repository channel statistics path, which is kept only as a diagnostic
acquisition_note: Four published files were downloaded and SHA256-verified against their published digests before this plan file was committed; slope_mask.npy declares the same digest as elevation_mask.npy and was nevertheless fetched separately. No pixel comparison ran before the plan was written.
test_geography_policy: Only Train/Val tiles are selected for comparison. Full-file SHA256 of the published arrays and the global packed-mask count necessarily stream bytes covering every latitude; those bytes are hashed or counted, never decoded into per-tile values for Test geography.
